visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a brightly lit indoor corner with a gray door and white walls, a young boy with dark hair, wearing a black and white horizontally striped t-shirt and blue shorts, stands leaning against the wall. He looks down at his bare feet with a pained and upset facial expression, while a small light-colored object, possibly a hair tie, sits on the wooden floor nearby. (2) As the scene continues, the boy remains in the same position but his emotional distress becomes more apparent as his eyes fill with tears. He repeatedly wipes his eyes and forehead with his right arm while attempting to maintain a stoic facial expression, showing a tense body posture and tight lips as he tries to hold back his crying. (3) A man with brown hair wearing a light beige shirt enters from the right side of the frame and kneels down to the boy's level. The boy finally breaks his composure and begins to sob openly, resting his head on the man's shoulder as they share a tight, comforting hug in the corner of the room.

The delivery is at a moderate pitch and conversational loudness, exhibiting clear articulation against a very quiet indoor room tone background. The signal-to-noise ratio is excellent with no background music initially present. (2) A high-pitched, shaky child's voice responds with a single-word denial. The vocal quality is extremely breathy and shows high spectral tension, indicating significant emotional distress. There is a noticeable pause of over one second, representing a high speech pause density as the child hesitates. (3) The dialogue escalates as the child's vocalizations turn into audible, rhythmic sobbing and sniffles. The vocal pitch contour rises sharply at the end of phrases. The father's voice remains calm and low in volume, providing a soothing contrast to the child's high-arousal distress. (4) A sentimental Mandarin pop ballad gradually fades into the mix, featuring a slow tempo of approximately 68 BPM. The arrangement consists of a soft acoustic piano and gentle sustained strings in a minor mode, establishing a melancholic yet supportive emotional atmosphere for the narrative. (5) As the child finally releases his emotions, the music swells in volume to become the dominant layer. A male vocalist begins singing emotional lyrics, while the father's spoken comfort becomes a soft, low-intensity whisper. The audio concludes with the music and vocal tracks blending into a heartwarming resolution.
